title: From History to Signal
thesis: Turn one oversized career document into a proof beam: scan less, say more, and make the future unmistakable.
carrier: One large career document whose active proof line creates a direct beam toward FUTURE YOU.
constraints: One dominant explanatory object per frame
Large readable type and calm spacing
No overlapping illustrations or miniature card clusters
No progress rail or persistent scene counter
Existing narration, audio bytes, and timing remain unchanged

milestones.state: Dense career page; future target is hard to see.
Scan window isolates Results, Scope, and Alignment one at a time.
Duty language and current-role framing fail to create a forward signal.
The same proof line becomes measurable and activates the beam.
Select, Rewrite, and Point forward transform the same document in sequence.
Irrelevant history recedes; selected evidence connects now to next.
Resume and LinkedIn align into one clear signal reaching FUTURE YOU and YES.
